ui.Hero.message003: ResearchHub is a shared workspace for students and researchers. Collect your sources, write the report side by side and ask AI questions that stay grounded in your own files, with every claim traceable to where it came from.
ui.Hero.message006: No credit card required. Free plan, no time limit.
ui.Pricing.message003: Simple plans that grow with your research.
ui.Pricing.message004: Start free with your group. Move to Premium when your libraries, analyses and team outgrow the basics.
ui.Pricing.message005: Prices in USD. Fair-use limits keep ResearchHub fast for all groups; you will see a clear message and a retry time if you reach one.
ui.Sections.message002: Chat with a PDF is not research.
ui.Sections.message003: Most AI tools answer and move on. Research needs the opposite: an answer you can check, a draft you can defend and a result you can repeat. ResearchHub was built around that, from the first upload to the final report.
ui.Sections.message006: Five screens, one workflow: bring in the sources, ask, write, analyze and keep the evidence attached the whole way.
ui.Sections.message008: Everything a research group needs, in one workspace.
ui.Sections.message010: From first upload to finished report in four steps.
ui.Sections.message012: Made for people who have to show their work.
ui.Sections.message017: Create an account, add your sources and ask your first question in a few minutes. Already have a workspace? Pick up where you left it.
ui.Sections.message018: From sources and raw data to a reproducible collaborative report.
ui.landingContent.message002: One shared place for the whole group.
ui.landingContent.message003: Every workspace brings the team, the sources, the report and the AI history together, so nobody has to ask where the latest version lives.
ui.landingContent.message004: ResearchHub workspace overview for an electronics lab: recent documents, recent AI questions and a box to ask across all sources.
ui.landingContent.message006: Upload once. Everyone works from the same files.
ui.landingContent.message007: PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, CSV data and plain text are processed and indexed, so AI can quote them and your team can open the exact passage.
ui.landingContent.message008: ResearchHub source library listing six lab files with type, uploader, date and ready status.
ui.landingContent.message010: Choose which sources AI may use, ask in plain language and get an answer where every claim links back to the passage that supports it.
ui.landingContent.message011: ResearchHub Ask AI page with a grounded answer about the time constant of an RC circuit, citations S1 to S3 and a source scope panel.
ui.landingContent.message013: Write the report with AI beside you, not instead of you.
ui.landingContent.message014: Draft a section from selected sources, rewrite a paragraph or look for evidence behind a claim. Suggestions change the document only after you accept them.
ui.landingContent.message015: ResearchHub document editor with a lab report on the left and a research conversation with a grounded answer in the side panel.
ui.landingContent.message016: From a spreadsheet to a chart you can reproduce.
ui.landingContent.message017: Pick a dataset, describe the calculation and ResearchHub plans it, runs the code in an isolated sandbox and keeps the inputs, code and result together.
ui.landingContent.message018: ResearchHub new analysis form with a measurements spreadsheet selected, its columns and sample rows, and a plain-language request.
ui.landingContent.message033: Lab reports without the version chaos.
ui.landingContent.message035: Literature and data in one trail of evidence.

ui.landingContent.message036: Recent documents, sources and AI activity at a glance
ui.landingContent.message037: Owner, Editor and Viewer roles for every member
ui.landingContent.message038: Ask a question straight from the overview
ui.landingContent.message040: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV and TXT up to 50 MB
ui.landingContent.message041: Every upload is an immutable version; replacing a file keeps the old one
ui.landingContent.message042: Clear status for each file: uploaded, processing, ready or failed
ui.landingContent.message043: You always see the scope: which sources the answer is based on
ui.landingContent.message044: Citations open the exact fragment, not just the file
ui.landingContent.message045: When the sources are not enough, it says so instead of guessing
ui.landingContent.message046: Comments, history and named snapshots for the whole team
ui.landingContent.message047: Content origin keeps human, AI, imported and analysis-derived text apart
ui.landingContent.message048: Research conversation next to the editor, with the same citations
ui.landingContent.message050: Inspect sheets, columns and sample rows before you run anything
ui.landingContent.message051: Python runs in a locked-down sandbox, never inside the app
ui.landingContent.message052: Insert the result into the report and trace it back to the data
ui.landingContent.message053: One library per workspace for lectures, papers, instructions and datasets. Files are versioned and never silently overwritten.
ui.landingContent.message054: Ask across all or selected sources. Each claim links to its fragment, and weak evidence is reported as insufficient.
ui.landingContent.message055: Generate a section from chosen sources, rewrite a selection or find support for a claim. You accept, edit or reject.
ui.landingContent.message056: One report, many authors. Anchored comment threads, version history and named snapshots keep the group in sync.
ui.landingContent.message057: Describe a calculation in plain language. Tables and charts keep their dataset, code and execution record.
ui.landingContent.message058: See what was written by a person, drafted by AI, imported or derived from an analysis, and which sources it relied on.
ui.landingContent.message059: Put sources side by side to spot where they agree, differ or contradict each other, with the evidence for each side.
ui.landingContent.message060: Uploads are inspected, costly operations are rate limited, prompts are screened and AI code never runs in the app itself.
ui.landingContent.message061: AI works from the files your group chose. If the evidence is missing, you get “not enough evidence”, which is useful research information, not an error.
ui.landingContent.message062: Suggestions never replace your text on their own. Every change is proposed first, with the evidence beside it.
ui.landingContent.message063: A chart is more than an image. It remembers its data, code and run, so a result can be checked, repeated and trusted.
ui.landingContent.message064: Name it after the lab, course or paper and invite your group with the right roles.
ui.landingContent.message065: Upload lectures, papers, instructions and data. Processing runs in the background and shows its progress.
ui.landingContent.message066: Question the sources, draft sections with citations and turn measurements into charts.
ui.landingContent.message067: Accept what is right, comment on the rest and keep restore points as the report takes shape.
ui.landingContent.message068: Share the instructions, lectures and measurements with your group, then write the report together and keep every number tied to its data.
ui.landingContent.message069: Ask questions about lectures and instructions
ui.landingContent.message070: Draft sections from the right materials
ui.landingContent.message071: Analyze measurement files and insert the chart
ui.landingContent.message072: Collect papers and datasets, compare what they claim and write with every statement linked to where it came from.
ui.landingContent.message074: Check a claim against your own sources
ui.landingContent.message077: Everything you need to run a course project or a small study.
ui.landingContent.message082: 15 sources per workspace, up to 50 MB each
ui.landingContent.message084: AI drafting, rewriting and evidence checks (fair use)
ui.landingContent.message088: For research groups that live in ResearchHub every day.
ui.landingContent.message091: Premium billing opens soon. Your workspaces carry over.
ui.landingContent.message095: Higher AI limits and priority processing
ui.landingContent.message096: Unlimited data analyses with full execution history
ui.landingContent.message100: Will the AI make things up?
ui.landingContent.message101: ResearchHub answers from the sources you select and links every claim to the passage behind it. When the retrieved evidence is not enough, it tells you that instead of inventing an answer. You can always open the cited fragment and check it yourself.
ui.landingContent.message103: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV and plain-text files up to 50 MB each. Uploads are inspected before processing, and a file that cannot be processed fails with a clear reason and a way to retry.
ui.landingContent.message104: Who can see what is in my workspace?
ui.landingContent.message105: Only the people you add. Owners manage the workspace, Editors upload sources and write, and Viewers can read and ask questions without changing anything. Access is checked on every request.
ui.landingContent.message106: Can I run calculations on my own data?
ui.landingContent.message107: Yes. Pick a spreadsheet or CSV, describe the calculation and ResearchHub plans and runs it in an isolated sandbox. The result keeps its inputs, code and run, and your original data stays unchanged.
ui.landingContent.message108: Can I use it alone, without a group?
ui.landingContent.message109: Of course. A workspace with one member works the same way: sources, grounded answers, drafting and analyses. Invite others whenever you are ready.
ui.landingContent.message111: Premium is on the way. Create a free account today and your workspaces, sources and documents stay exactly where they are when plans change.
